title: reader 3: Quick illustration of how one can easily read books together with LLMs  #github
description:
reader 3 — a self-hosted EPUB reader designed for one simple mission: reading books together with your LLM. It lets you load any EPUB and go through it chapter by chapter, making it super easy to copy, paste, and discuss the text with your favorite model. Perfect for grabbing classics from Project Gutenberg and turning them into an interactive reading session. 
#github #opensource
